text.p: Shareholders of Telemisr/Arab Radio Transistor and Electronics Supplies approved an annual dividend of 3.23 pounds for 1995/6 on Monday, shareholders said.
The company made net after-tax profits of 12 million pounds ($3.53 million) in the financial year, which ended on June 30, 10 percent up on 10.906 million in the previous year.
The 1994/5 dividend was paid to the state, before this year's privatisation of the company, and the amount was not immediately available.
The board told the meeting that sales in the first five months of 1996/7 were sharply up, at 36 million pounds against 19 million in the same period of last year, they said.
The shareholders said the board wanted to increase the company's capital some time next year, probably through a one-for-seven share issue.
The state sold 76.26 percent of the two milliom shares in September at 30.00 pounds a share and the shares closed on the Egyptian stock exchange on Monday at 32.50 pounds.
